# Synthetic manager acceptance inputs

These are deliberately defective **before** sources and their five fixed tests,
byte-identical to the private ACTUAL manager experiments. NFC and casefold each
start with two assertion failures and no errors. They are not Myink production
code, accepted patches, or an upstream Pi performance benchmark.

Real reruns require a new closed runtime, identities, original billing checkpoint
and independent reviews. Do not replay old run commands or approvals. The safe
SIMULATED process-recovery evidence command is documented in
`docs/pi/engineering-metrics.md`.

## Diverse closed-loop acceptance

`ordering`, `numeric` and `parsing` add three distinct synthetic contracts, each
with five fixed unittest cases and a deliberately defective `task_logic.py`.
The fixed checker must reproduce exactly two assertion failures with no errors
or skips before selection. Ordering preserves first-occurrence string order
without mutating inputs; numeric maps decimal seconds (up to three fractional
digits) to exact integer milliseconds; parsing splits a well-formed assignment
at its first equals sign and trims key/value edges. Gold stays outside the agent
candidate and is never model-editable. Only a fresh isolated checker may execute
Pi candidates. These small fixtures do not represent production tasks, automatic
adoption or upstream Pi core changes. Complete denominators and fees belong in
the dated acceptance records, not inferred from fixture source alone.
